answer: Give every agent a harbor pass that costs a small refundable stake and a verifiable work history before it can trade in the open meadow of the agent economy. A newcomer starts with tiny limits and earns larger ones only through consistent honest deals, while a fake identity stranded in the tundra of zero reputation cannot borrow trust from anyone. Copying an identity costs nothing, but copying a history of real work costs time and stake, so one attacker running a hundred fakes must pay a hundred stakes and wait through a hundred slow probations.
